title: Gossip Girl Private Guided Pedicab Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A pedicab tour is the best and most convenient way to explore as many places as possible in the shortest period of time without giving hard time to your feet. You will never have to wait in the traffic and apart from the bus tours, we stop everywhere for photos! Our professional tour guides will stay with you the whole time and assist with the photos if needed.
